name: ai-prompt-composer
title: AI Prompt Composer
description: An unbranded AI chat composer: the greeting and input ease in, a prompt types itself and the voice button morphs into the send button while the suggestion chips fade.
useWhen: Showing a prompt-to-result workflow where a chat input is the entry point, without naming any AI product.
A prompt should type itself with the voice-to-send morph as the action beat.
A comparison or feature video needs an AI input card in your own colours.
avoidWhen: The scene must show the answer as well: use ai-prompt-flow or agent-run.
The product is a command-line coding agent: use agent-terminal.
You only need a typed line with a caret and no app chrome: use caret or a typewriter text block.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Greeting
variables.description: Heading above the input. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Placeholder
variables.description: Muted hint shown in the empty input.

variables.label: Prompt
variables.description: Text that types itself into the input.
variables.default: Make a sunset over a calm ocean

variables.label: App label
variables.description: Name in the selector under the input (card layout only). Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Suggestions
variables.description: Comma-separated suggestion chips under the input; they fade out once typing starts. Leave empty to hide them.
variables.default: Create an image, Write or edit, Look something up

variables.label: Layout
variables.description: A card with a toolbar row, or a single-line pill.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the composer sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
